Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 2, Verse 69

“What is night for all beings is waking for the disciplined one; what is waking for all beings is night for the sage who sees.”

A striking inversion. The sage is not more awake than others in the same direction, but awake to a different order of things, and asleep to what everyone else stays up for.
